caption: The drawing depicts a tall, freestanding grandfather clock with a wooden case. The case is primarily a reddish-brown color with visible wood grain patterns and gold-colored trim outlining several panel sections. The clock has a rectangular base with a slightly raised panel, a central section with a vertical rectangular door, and an upper section containing the clock face. The upper part of the clock has an arched, bonnet-style top with decorative scrollwork and a finial in the center. The clock face is a light, pale color with black Arabic numerals marking the hours and two ornate, dark-colored clock hands. Above the clock face, there is a painted decorative floral motif in soft colors. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige. In the bottom right corner, there is a small printed or signed name reading "A. Marcilian."
title: Tall Clock
